quotes.text: With the rise of AI data centers and other technological advances, we need every electron we can get to keep our state, and nation, powered. Georgia must ensure we have the tools to properly arm our grid with the resources needed to continue serving the community without delays or outages.
We can lead the world in artificial intelligence and protect the family budget at the same time. Those goals are not mutually exclusive.
America can lead in artificial intelligence. Georgia can continue attracting jobs and investment. And hardworking families should not automatically be stuck with the tab.

We understand now, to your point, the demand for energy. That’s why I’m an all-of-the-above type energy strategist, because we are going to need every electron we can get. We all know how much data centers in AI are going to demand.
We cannot afford to lose this race to China. We cannot afford to lose the AI race to China. If we do, then God help us, and China’s trying to do it.

Nuclear energy is key to powering America’s future.

With AI and crypto surging, we need every electron available to lead in these areas.

AI should never have the final say on your health care. Period.

Insurance companies shouldn’t be able to hide behind an algorithm to deny patients the care they need.

Doctors make medical decisions. Not computers.

The Doctors Not AI Act makes sure it stays that way, and I am proud to co-lead this bipartisan effort and look forward to its passage.

Every patient’s medical needs are unique and decisions about their care require the judgment of a qualified health care professional, not an algorithm. While AI can help make the claims process more efficient, it should never have the final say in denying someone access to medically necessary care. I am proud to co-lead the Doctors Not AI Act to put patients first, preserve independent clinical judgment, and bring greater transparency and accountability to insurers’ use of AI.

We know we need data centers. We know that we’re in a race with AI, with China, and we know that we’ve got to win that race. We know how important it is. [...] They have to understand that we can ill afford to lose this AI race with China. We can’t let them win this race. AI is amazing what it can do. Yes, there are concerns and we should be addressing those concerns. But at the same time, we cannot afford to lose this race with AI.

Yes, I do believe we do. We’ve got to get this under control. AI is the future, we know that. … But some of these ads are just ridiculous, and we have to get this under control. I would like to think that the AI companies could do it themselves through self-regulation. But I’m afraid that we are going to have to have a hand in it in Congress. I don’t want to stifle innovation. I don’t think any of us do. But, at the same time, we want to make sure that we are not being taken for with AI.
